title: Paraglide Moab
specs: Flights reach altitudes between 1500-3000 ft above the ground depending on conditions
Passengers must be between 80 and 270 pounds and able to run a dozen steps
Anyone older than 15 years old can fly if they weigh at least 80 pounds and can take a dozen running steps
blurb: Guests experience tandem paragliding flights guided by expert instructors, soaring above Moab's breathtaking desert landscapes. Flights use a payout/payin winch mounted to a tow vehicle to launch and climb. Passengers freefly back down after reaching altitudes between 1500-3000 ft.
